integrity: Exact integer-layer count is proved, and an independent standalone verifier checks direct binomial GCDs through n=150, factorization-based layers through X=20000, and exact large census counts. Finite checks do not replace the PNT proof.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic per fixed exponent only; no uniform-in-exponent estimate or exact positive-GCD valuation is claimed. The theorem uses Guo et al. Theorem 1 and the classical prime number theorem.
title: Prime-power layers of nontrivial binomial GCDs without large prime factors
